Direct Cayley difference analysis yields P=8z (rank3), 24z² (rank4 parallelogram), 16z (rank4 no parallelogram), 16z²+120z⁴ (rank5). Independently enumerated maximal-compatible sets of all four canonical groups and the five-cube 6-set census 17360,416640,27776,444416; all agree. The rank5 coding proof excludes maximal triples and counts antipodal pairs and 4-codes. Complete proof extends to all dimensions by coset factorization; finite checks only establish local counts.
